richiami.difetto: It has been identified that; due to the possibility of steering tie rod arm  out of specification surface finish it's securing bolts may become loose.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the steering tie rod arm checked and modified as necessary. Additionally the securing bolts will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: STEERING SYSTEM BOLTS MAY BECOME LOOSE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the rear wheel sensors may be incorrectly connected which if ignored could result in loss of vehicle stability under braking/acceleration
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check/rectify wheel sensor connections

richiami.difetto: The Load Sensing Valve (LSV) may have been incorrectly set which may result in lower than expected brake efficiency in the laden condition.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehices and reset Load Sensing Valve.

richiami.difetto: Desiccant granules in the Haldex air dryer can become pulverised and cause an internal blockage in the unit. The consequent pressure increase in the dryer may cause the unit to explode.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and depending on chassis type either:- A) On 4500 Series fit a ping tank between the compressor and the air dryer and change the desiccant cartridge. In addition a tamper proof safety valve will be fitted to the dryer

richiami.difetto: Two instances have occurred whereby push in connections used on the air braking system have disconnected. This has only happened where pipe reducers have been used.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace all push-in connections on the air braking system with compression joints.
richiami.titolo: DISCONNECTION OF CERTAIN BRAKING SYSTEM PUSH-IN FITTINGS

richiami.difetto: A pin within the engine governor servo cylinder assembly may disengage. This could result in the governor failing to control the engine speed.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the governor rack servo assembly with a quality assured unit.
